package tabs // import "ubunatic.com/loom/examples/tabs/tabs"

Package tabs is experimental; its API may change between releases. See
docs/APIStability.md for the package stability policy.

Package tabs demonstrates the loom.Tabs widget hosting child widgets with
declarative key bindings, dynamic tab manipulation, and interactive chrome.

FUNCTIONS

func NewWidget(args []string) (loom.Widget, error)
    NewWidget builds the tabs example's root widget from command-line args,
    without creating or running a Pane.

func Run(args []string) error
    Run runs the tabs example with cobra command support.
